parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance to which the VPC-connected instance is connected
parameters.help_zh: VPC实例连接的云企业网实例的ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC-connected instance
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of a vSwitch in the VPC-connected instance.

You can query network interface controller (NIC) information for only one vSwitch at a time
parameters.help_zh:
VPC实例下的一个交换机ID。

一次仅支持查询一个交换机下的弹性网卡的信息
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

If this is the first query or no next query exists, leave this parameter empty.
If a next query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次 API 调用返回的 NextToken 值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 10 to 500.

Default value:
If you do not set this parameter, the default value is 20.
If the value you set is greater than 500, the default value is 500
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页的最大条目数。取值范围：10~500。

默认值：
当不设置值时，默认值为20。
当设置的值大于500时，默认值为500
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The IDs of network interface controllers (NICs)
parameters.name: network_interface_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs). You can use this parameter to filter network interface controllers (NICs) by name
parameters.name: network_interface_name

parameters.help_en: The primary private IP IPv4 address of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs). You can use this parameter to filter network interface controllers (NICs) by primary private IP address
